title: 1.5 mile to DT & 12th South: Beautiful Studio
description:
We are following the recommended cleaning checklist provided by Airbnb. 

Space is perfect for a Nashville getaway.  If you and a friend, family member or loved one are visiting Nashville look no further as this place is perfect. It is located upstairs above a garage, but the garage isn’t being used by anyone so you shouldn’t hear any noise from its doors. Included is free parking.

The space
This space is on a property as a guest house. You will have a private entrance to the space and there are indoor stairs that lead to the studio space. We have designed the studio to feel clean, modern, and upscale as we want it to be more than just a place for you to sleep. 

We live about 2 miles away and am happy to help in any sort of way. You can access the home without any interaction or I am happy to meet you should that be your preference and I am available.

Guest access
Make yourself at home!
